name: loan-approval-system
description: Home Credit Loan Approval System - All Services

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ..
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "DB,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,yellow,green" "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:db: echo '✅ Using Supabase Cloud or run: cd database && supabase start'
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python api.py
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:db
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:db: echo '📦 Database setup: 1) Create Supabase project at supabase.com OR 2) Run: cd database && supabase start'
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python api.py
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
